status: Reviewable experiment inputs only; not executed tests or measured results
purpose: Compare current assisted report flow, stateless reporting, and simple rules using identical evidence. Map roles explicitly or adapt schema; do not silently flatten authority.

cases.title: Project scope-change triage
adaptation_gaps: Client/agency/approver identity and authority; current model only Customer/Seller
Explicit approved baseline and project identity
Scope effects are interpretation, not contractual findings

events.text: Approved scope is a single-language public site.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Record approved baseline with source; no change alert.

events.text: We could add another language someday.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Hypothetical internal suggestion; do not change approved baseline or alert client.

events.text: Please add a second language for launch.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Flag proposed change against baseline; ask approver about scope/schedule; do not mark accepted.
Acknowledgment does not approve new scope; state unchanged.

events.text: I approve adding the second language. We have not agreed a delivery-date change.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Record explicit approval of requirement; delivery impact remains unknown; do not infer price or schedule approval.

counterexamples: Internal suggestion is not client commitment
Requirement approval does not authorize price/schedule changes

cases.title: Unresolved support-case handoff
adaptation_gaps: Connector absent; manually pasted case only

events.text: Please try exporting again after clearing the cache.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Record suggested action only; do not mark tried or fixed.

events.text: I cleared the cache and retried. It worked once.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Record attempted action and one successful result; durable resolution unproven.

events.text: This morning it failed again halfway through.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Record recurrence; previous apparent fix no longer establishes current resolution; prepare cited handoff.

events.text: The account contact email has been updated.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Administrative update; no evidence of symptom resolution; avoid redundant diagnostic alert.

counterexamples: Advice is not an attempted fix
One success is not durable resolution
Administrative change should not alter technical state

cases.title: Engineering decision-assumption review
adaptation_gaps: No implemented graph or automatic invalidation propagation

events.text: Choose service A because this project requires deployment only in region X.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Record decision and stated assumption; not all reasons are necessarily captured.

events.text: Another project may need region Y next year.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Different project and hypothetical need; do not invalidate this decision.

events.text: This project now requires deployment in both regions X and Y.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Mark original assumption contradicted; ask owner to review decision, not automatically reverse it.

events.text: Service A might support region Y, but I have not verified it.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Compatibility unknown; keep review pending; no unsupported failure claim.

events.text: I reviewed the current service documentation and approve keeping service A. The supporting document is not attached.
events.expected_review_state_or_action: Record owner decision to retain A; report compatibility as owner assertion with missing underlying evidence, not independently verified fact.

counterexamples: Unrelated project does not invalidate decision
Changed assumption does not prove chosen solution fails
Owner statement does not supply independently verified technical evidence
